reminder.notes:
# Reminder 2.30.2 - Launcher Icon Monochrome & Dynamic Theme Support

### Features
- Added monochrome adaptive icon layer to `launcher_icon.xml` matching `android:roundIcon` and `android:icon`, ensuring seamless tinting with wallpaper dynamic palettes and dark mode on Android 13-17.

### Bug fixes
- Fixed reminder app keeping legacy icon on devices using circular launchers.

mirrordrive.notes:
# MirrorDrive 1.1.3 - Icon Overhaul & Gradient Alignment

### Features
- Restored deep blue diagonal gradient background plate and glossy white two-way sync loop vector.
- Aligned adaptive monochrome icon layer centered in the safe zone without clipping.

### Bug fixes
- Removed flat grey background color and conflicting raster drawables that degraded icon appearance.

twinclean.notes:
# TwinClean 1.5.2 - Themed Icon & Round Launcher Support

### Features
- Added explicit round icon declaration (`android:roundIcon`) and synced monochrome adaptive icon layer for Android 13-17 launchers.

### Bug fixes
- Fixed launcher icon not updating on circular launcher environments.

taashclub.notes:
# Taash Club 1.21.3 - Redesigned Cards & Table Icon

### Features
- Redesigned playing card emblem with fanned trio of cards and prominent Ace of Spades.
- Added deep casino green poker felt table background with subtle rim vignette.
- Added razor-sharp monochrome stencil layer for Android 13-17 Material You themed icons.

### Bug fixes
- Fixed deformed monochrome silhouette and jagged table shadow in adaptive launcher icons.

cards.notes:
# Cards 2.7.2 - Transparent Themed Icon & Round Launcher Support

### Features
- Added pure transparent monochrome adaptive icon layer, ensuring the card emblem renders cleanly on Android 13-17 Material You wallpaper themes and dark mode without solid background fill.
- Added explicit round icon support (`android:roundIcon`) for circular launcher environments.

### Bug fixes
- Fixed launcher icon rendering solid square on themed home screens.

mailkeep.notes:
# Mailkeep 0.4.1 - Fix Google sign-in on 0.4.0

### Features
- No new features. Same Auto-organize rules as 0.4.0.

### Bug fixes
- Fixed Google sign-in failing ("Account reauth failed") on 0.4.0: that build was signed with the wrong key. This build uses the production release key. Uninstall 0.4.0 first, then install this version.

routerwarden.notes:
Router Warden 1.1.3

### Features
- New switch on the 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz and Guest Wi-Fi cards to hide or show the network name. Hiding asks for confirmation first.

### Bug fixes
- No user-facing bug fixes in this release.
